fields.Name: Dual-Axis Time Series with 4-Level Drill-Down
fields.Description: Skip analytics conversation from the More Cheese suite

fields.Message: I need a comprehensive dashboard showing our membership and revenue trends over the past 5 years. Create a line chart with two Y-axes: the left axis should show membership count (as a line), and the right axis should show total revenue (as a different colored line). Make the chart interactive so that when I click on any data point, it opens up a pie chart breaking down that specific year's activity by category (membership fees, event revenue, course revenue). Then, when I click on any slice of that pie chart, show me a detailed table of all the transactions in that category for that year. Finally, make sure I can click on any row in that transaction table to open the actual invoice or membership record in the system. I want to see clear axis labels, a legend distinguishing the two metrics, and smooth navigation through all four levels. [NO CHAT]

Here you go, your Membership & Revenue Trends Dashboard is ready, combining longitudinal analytics from Membership Periods and Order Headers. It features a 5-year dual-axis chart comparing active members against gross revenue, an interactive category breakdown chart, and a searchable transaction ledger. You can drill down seamlessly through all four levels and click any transaction or member name to open the live record directly in MemberJunction.
